title: Spin-scaled double hybrids with long-range correction solve the TD-DFT overestimation problem in BODIPY dyes: benchmarking and experimental validation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,22419-22431
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01408E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Shebual Sebastian, Vaughan Riley, Binuki Wanniarachchi, Chris Ritchie, Lars Goerigk
Via benchmarking and experimental cross-validation on newly synthesised systems, we identify robust TD-DFT methods that overcome the notorious overestimation trend in BODIPY dyes, thereby aiding in the reliable prediction of future BODIPYs.
